selected_script.angle: A vertical drying solution that stops damp clothes from smelling up tight spaces with zero setup stress
selected_script.hook: That musty smell in your room? It is your wet clothes taking over. Let us fix this.

video_001_part_01.voiceover: Wife: Honey! [0-1.5s] / Husband in tuxedo: Fresh air incoming! [1.5-3s] / Easily dry everything in one clean spot. [3-10s]

video_001_part_02.voiceover: Organize your laundry in seconds. Fold it down flat and store it away. A simple upgrade for everyday use.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical UGC ad video. Timeline: 0-1.5s: Show a real daily pain point of damp, crumpled jeans and towels draped over a dusty radiator. No product and no rescuer. 1.5-3s: An absurd adult husband in a formal black tuxedo enters carrying the folded white accordion-style laundry drying rack under his arm, places it down on the clean floor next to the radiator, and says 'Fresh air incoming!'. 3-6s: The white accordion laundry rack is expanded beside the radiator. Two towels are placed flat on the top parallel rails, resolving the pile. 6-10s: Close-up of the scissor side frames and horizontal rails holding a few neatly hung pants. Keep the pacing fast, clear, low-risk, and product-focused. Use the provided product reference images as the exact product identity. Do not change the product color, shape, material, size ratio, logo position, texture, or visible structure. Do not invent extra accessories, buttons, lights, packaging, or exaggerated functions. Use the detail and side reference image to preserve product material, side structure, edge shape, texture, and visible details.
